item.text:
Fixed the parentheses rewrite so it preserves the pair required around `yield` and `yield from` expressions inside calls, while still removing redundant outer pairs. Added regression cases in [tests/pyupgrade_test.py](/testbed/tests/pyupgrade_test.py:506); the fix is in [pyupgrade.py](/testbed/pyupgrade.py:541).

Verification: all 325 tests passed, and the rewritten yield examples compile.
